origin.description: Remove a name from styles(). A name that is not there is ignored.
origin.details: The style functions created at load, such as red(), keep the codes they were built with. Dropping the name only changes styles() and the $ lookup.
origin.example:
invisible(make_style(new_style = "maroon", bg = TRUE))
cat(style("I am maroon", "new_style"), "\n", sep="")
drop_style("new_style")
cat("new_style" %in% names(styles()), "\n", sep="")

translation.description: Remove a name from styles(). A missing name is ignored.
translation.details: Returns None. red itself is unchanged if the name red is removed; later attribute lookup of .red fails because it reads styles().
translation.example:
make_style(**{"new_style": "maroon"}, bg=True)
print(style("I am maroon", "new_style"))
drop_style("new_style")
print("TRUE" if "new_style" in styles() else "FALSE")
